behavior: Current count-free/radius-based selector restricted to both leaves; baseline box-fallback and CP execution placement.
build_method: Recompile only archived baseline kick.cpp and kick.cu with edited selector arguments and current repository headers; reuse all adaptive before objects otherwise; regenerate CUDA device link and executable.
lifecycle: Both versions use this same benchmark-only harness: stop the memory daemon and wait for the HPX pool once before workloads; wait for pool quiescence after every kick inside its timed interval and before tree cleanup/reuse. Production source is unchanged.
